You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. The corridor has two long walls, the north wall and the south wall. You are 0.9 m from the north wall. You are walking east. Is the north wall on your left or on your right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Right
You are walking east, so north is on your left side; however, since you are 0.9 m from the north wall in a corridor 1.75 m wide, that wall is actually on your left—wait, correcting: facing east, north is to your left, so the north wall is on your left.
